headline: Bengala mine extending west to 2050, Acland strip ratios among lowest in industry, and Malibar underground investment ramping to 6Mt

It's a truck shovel and drag line operation. Long approved out to 2039. With the ramp up we are at 13.4 for me and Ron Tums now off the back of the growth project and that'll exhaust reserves by around about sort of 2036 2037. So with that that's really turned our mind to applying for extensions. I think the good thing when you look at both Queensland government and New South Wales government at the moment there's a realization that coal is critical to both of not only exports for the world but to the prosperity of both of those states. So it's good to see a lot of positive messaging coming out from both governments and we've seen that recently with the New South Wales statement on coal.
